Repeat mode (re-arm after every screen-on until stopped)
Repeat ON — idle timer re-arms after every wake-up.
Repeat OFF — one idle-off, then your original timeout is restored.

1. Go to your home screen and long-press an empty spot.
2. Tap “Widgets”.
3. Find “Screen Off Widget” and drag it anywhere.

No device admin and no accessibility — the app adjusts your system idle-screen timer (Display → Sleep), so the screen turns off exactly like natural idle. Banking-safe.

Both surfaces use the same delay: 1min / 2min / custom (3–3600 s). In the app the tabs only SELECT the delay and START arms it. On the widget the chips also arm instantly. Repeat switch: when ON, every screen-on re-arms the idle timer until you tap STOP; when OFF, your original timeout is restored after one idle-off.
